literal_meaning: পেটে চড়া বা টক পড়া (sourness or pungency falling into the stomach)
figurative_meaning_en: To lose appetite for food due to lack of variety
similar_in_english: Sick and tired of the same old thing
example_sentences_in_bangla: দিনের পর দিন একই খাবার খেয়ে তার পেটে চড়া পড়েছে।
ঘরে বৈচিত্র্যময় রান্না না থাকায় সবার চড়া পড়া হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After eating the same food day after day, sourness has fallen in his stomach.
Due to the lack of variety in home cooking, everyone has lost their appetite.
note: This idiom reflects the importance of culinary variety in Bengali daily life, often used in contexts of repetitive meals leading to boredom or mild indigestion.
